dialogue.content: (本日は宜しくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for joining me today. We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは初めに年齢、性別、今日ご相談したい事を教えてください
dialogue.English: Good evening. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 14歳男です
dialogue.English: I'm a 14-year-old boy.

dialogue.content: こんばんは今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: Good evening. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 何から言っていいのかわかりません
dialogue.English: I'm not sure where to begin.

dialogue.content: 話しやすいところからで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: That's okay, you can start from wherever you feel comfortable.

dialogue.content: 毎日がつらい
dialogue.English: Every day is tough.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね教えてくれてありがとう
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: どんな時つらいなと感じますか
dialogue.English: When do you find yourself feeling that way?

dialogue.content: 家にいるとき
dialogue.English: When I'm at home.

dialogue.content: 毎日、家にいるとき辛いんですねとてもしんどい状況なのですね
dialogue.English: So, every day when you're at home, it feels tough. That sounds like a really difficult situation.

dialogue.content: そう…
dialogue.English: Yeah...

dialogue.content: 家でつらくなるのはどういうときかもう少し詳しく話せますか話せるところからで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about when it feels tough at home? You can share whatever you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 夜、父さんが帰ってくるとイヤ
dialogue.English: I don't like it when my dad comes home at night.

dialogue.content: うんうん、お父さんが帰ってくると辛いことがあるんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so when your father comes home, something tough happens.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 毎日耐えてきたのですね、、お父さんが帰ってくると何があるのか教えてもらえますか
dialogue.English: You've been enduring this every day... Could you tell me what happens when your father comes home?

dialogue.content: イヤなこと
dialogue.English: Unpleasant things.

dialogue.content: そう嫌なことがあるんですねそれは言うのも辛いことかな
dialogue.English: I see, unpleasant things. Is it painful to even talk about?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうなんですねそんなに嫌な思いをしているんですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I understand. You're going through such unpleasant experiences.

dialogue.content: 今日ここに話に来てくれてありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming here to talk today.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 少し質問してもいいですか
dialogue.English: May I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: ありがとうお父さんにされることでケガしたりすることはないですか
dialogue.English: Thank you. Does your father ever do things that cause you to get injured?

dialogue.content: 血が出ることはないよ
dialogue.English: I don't bleed.

dialogue.content: 血はでないけど痛い思いをしたりする？
dialogue.English: So you don't bleed, but does he hurt you?

dialogue.content: 怖いこと
dialogue.English: Scary things.

dialogue.content: 怖い、、うんうん、すごく怖いね、、他に一緒に住んでいる家族はいますか
dialogue.English: Scary... I see. That sounds very scary... Do you have any other family members living with you?

dialogue.content: いません
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 二人で暮らしているんですね相談できるような人はいますか
dialogue.English: So it's just the two of you living together. Is there anyone you feel you could talk to about this?

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうなのね例えば、学校の先生とか大人に相談したことはありますか
dialogue.English: I see. For example, have you ever talked to a teacher or another adult about this?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: 一人で悩んできたんですねすごく怖かったですねいつごろからそんな怖い思いをしてきたのかな
dialogue.English: So you've been dealing with this all by yourself. That must have been so scary. How long have you been having these scary experiences?

dialogue.content: わからない　ずっと前
dialogue.English: I don't know. For a long time.

dialogue.content: 小さいころから？
dialogue.English: Since you were little?

dialogue.content: お母さんがいなくなった頃から
dialogue.English: From around the time Mom left.

dialogue.content: そうだったのね寂しい思いもしていたんですね
dialogue.English: I see. You must have been feeling lonely, too.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そう、、寂しくて当然ですよね、、
dialogue.English: Yes... it's completely natural to feel lonely.

dialogue.content: 昼間はどのように過ごしていますか
dialogue.English: How do you spend your days?

dialogue.content: 学校に行ってる
dialogue.English: I go to school.

dialogue.content: 学校に好きな先生はいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have a favorite teacher at school?

dialogue.content: 話を聞いてくれそうとか、、
dialogue.English: Someone who seems like they would listen to you...

dialogue.content: 話を聞いてくれるかはわかんないけど、好きな先生はいる
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if they'd listen, but there is a teacher I like.

dialogue.content: そうなのねとても怖い思いを近くの大人に相談したほうがいいと感じました。もしうまく言えなかったらこのラインをその先生に見せても大丈夫なので一度その好きな先生に相談してみるのはどうかな
dialogue.English: I see. I feel it's important for you to talk to a nearby adult about these very scary experiences. If you can't find the words, it's okay to show this chat to that teacher. How about trying to talk to the teacher you like?

dialogue.content: 好きだから、話したくない
dialogue.English: Because I like them, I don't want to tell them.

dialogue.content: そうそれはどうして？
dialogue.English: I see. Why is that?

dialogue.content: 話したら嫌われる
dialogue.English: If I tell them, they'll hate me.

dialogue.content: うんうん、なるほど、、嫌われるかもと感じているんですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, I see. So you feel that they might dislike you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: どうして嫌いになると思うのかな
dialogue.English: What makes you think they would start to dislike you?

dialogue.content: …わかんない
dialogue.English: ...I don't know.

dialogue.content: そう感じてしまうのですね、、
dialogue.English: That's how it feels to you...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね今日はお時間がきてしまったけどまた辛くなったらここにお話ししに来てくれますか
dialogue.English: I understand. We've run out of time for today, but if things get tough again, would you be willing to come back and talk here?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 終了のメッセージが流れますこちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: You'll see the end-of-session message. Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
